This bar has so much potential, but ………….
Sep 2026 • Friends
Latest Review: September 2026

After living in Da Nang for over 2 years, I thought I’d come back and see if anything has improved since my previous visits.

Service:
- My order was taken at 11:42
- My drink was delivered at 11:45 👏👏👏
- The service started off Great, but then everyone disappeared 😢
- The staff I interacted with were so miserable, and it was clear they didn’t want to be there.
- When you work in the service / hospitality industry, you always need to try and be happy. Nobody wants to interact with miserable people.
- Rating: 2/5

* Atmosphere:
- They still don’t play music.
- Please explain to me why a bar located in such a premium beach location doesn’t play any music, especially when there are more and more beach bars opening every month. 🤷🏼‍♂️
- Rating: 3/5 (If they played some music it would be a solid 5/5)

Overall Rating: 2/5 (Nothing has changed 😢)

If they start playing some music and improve the service, this could easily be one of the best bars in Da Nang.

—————————————————————————-

Original Review:

- Great Location, lovely views of the beach & ocean
- Good Happy Hour, but watch out as they don’t track the drinks and try to over charge you
- The atmosphere is very hit and miss as sometimes they play music, but other times there is no music, which is very strange
- Food: I haven’t tried
- The service is terrible!
